Thanks for the suggestion. I first tried let Some(expire_time) = … else { return None; }, but Clippy warned to use the ? operator instead. So I updated it to: let expire_time = json["data"]["expire_time"].as_str()?;
Thanks for the reminder — I’ll make sure to keep all code comments in English in the next commit

Thanks for the review!
I’ll simplify parsing with let Ok(...) else, expose both expire_time and expire_date for consistency, and move all per‑variable logic into the mappers. These changes will be included in the next commit.
